description: Draft objects from local OpenAPI, JSON Schema, Postgres SQL, Prisma, dbt, OData or GraphQL files, then apply accepted proposals. Use it when importing a schema; use object_import_read to review a staged object. Returns importId, staged files, proposal counts and re-import differences, or batch registration results. draft takes source.path or source.content; apply requires explicit objects and proposal ids. overwrite replaces team objects; confirmShipped names approved shipped replacements. No network fetch or code execution. Full schema: oods://schemas/object_import.input.json.

confirmShipped.description: Each shipped object name whose replacement is explicitly confirmed.

importId.description: Content-addressed import id from draft. Required by show and apply.

objects.description: Explicit accepted object names and optional proposal ids for apply.

items.description: objects item. Fields: name, proposals, currencies. See full schema.

source.description: Local file/folder or inline schema. Used only by draft.

content.description: Inline schema text, at most 1 MiB. Set format for SQL, Prisma, OData XML or GraphQL SDL.

format.description: Explicit source format; inferred from file extension or document when omitted.

name.description: File name for inline provenance; no directories.

path.description: Local file or folder. References must stay inside the source folder. Aggregate limit 128 MiB.

name: object_import
title: Import Objects
